
## Summary

**Add screenshot and accessibility regression matrix** (residual after DUX5)

Current screenshots reveal width-sensitive failures but no automated prevention is shown.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P3**
- Wave: **V4**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P3-02`
- DUX code: `DUX6-31`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: all groups + viewports

## Concrete change

Render target states at 1366×768, 1440×900, 1920×1080, 100/125% zoom, supported themes. Check clipping, scrollbars, text floors and contrast tokens.

## Expected effect

Readability defects become merge-blocking rather than incident-time discoveries.

## Acceptance criteria

- Before/after screenshots stored; defined assertions pass; dark theme verified and light theme either verified or explicitly unsupported.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Grafana renderer/browser automation.

## Risk

Screenshot tests can be brittle; use semantic thresholds and stable fixtures.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7133 DUX5-31 closed — residual: live screenshot matrix not automated

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card

DUX6 epic (#7139)
